requiredFindings.location: Section 1 B2-b2 vectors; LD-B2B-3 and LD-B2B-5
requiredFindings.title: Define a usable current-reference oracle and separate pending records from V3 serialization
requiredFindings.finding: The unchanged SLM imports the original DD, initializes provenance with schemaVersion 2, and recognizes only provenance versions 1 and 2. It lacks SX-1 and the accepted pruning-reference corrections. Its outputs cannot both reproduce byte for byte and validate as B-S1 V3. The planned Pending workspaceDeclarations also cannot validate as DiscoveryProvenanceV3. X2-only case supersessions do not resolve these differences.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Specify the reviewed reference/projection path for B2-a pruning corrections, SX-1 and V3, explicitly separating historical SLM replay from current expected behavior. State which partial fields can be compared before B3-b, which complete outputs actually undergo V3 validation, and how the pending internal type is prevented from being accepted or serialized as current provenance. Preserve B3-b ownership without inventing absent reader observations.

requiredFindings.location: Section 1 B2-b3, each listed parent and observed-tree output; B2-b2 source selection
requiredFindings.title: Choose the unit source before deciding traversal scope
requiredFindings.finding: The walker is specified as descending ordinary directories from the selected root and producing the observed tree before the core chooses explicit/config/automatic discovery. That widens an explicit source into a whole-root scan, contrary to MB item 13: explicit and configured roots are exact roots, never scan roots. Unrelated subtrees could consume the ledger or produce observations/refusals for an invocation that selected only a small root.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Define separate observation strategies selected before walking. Explicit/config modes must observe only named roots and the necessary ancestor, boundary and pruning evidence; automatic mode may recursively enumerate. Add trace and budget controls proving that unrelated sibling and descendant trees are not scanned and that an admitted array does not fall through to automatic discovery.

requiredFindings.location: Section 1 B2-b4, LD-B2B-4, section 3 completion condition
requiredFindings.title: Retain the all-entry T2 margin as a B2-b acceptance gate
requiredFindings.finding: MB item 12 requires a twofold objects/edges margin for every pinned T2 entry before B2-b lands. The plan excludes ten held-out entries and transfers their margin to qualification while allowing B2-b completion after B2-b4. Preserving the no-inspection boundary is correct, but it does not authorize weakening that gate.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Keep all-entry margin evidence explicitly outstanding until an authorized harness supplies nondisclosing results for held-out entries, or obtain a separate accepted law change before altering the gate. The lead must not read held-outs. State that partial census success cannot complete B2-b. For a materialized-store census, require current integrity verification and no-follow counting equivalent to the pinned Git-tree population, with objects/edges margin distinguished from the separately bounded bytes.

requiredFindings.location: Section 0 custody; B2-b2 custody checker; B2-b3 analysis selection and LD-B2B-5
requiredFindings.title: Assign implementation and controls for the typed project-owner waiver
requiredFindings.finding: The plan notices that every native custody check uses waive_owner=false, but assigns no change that consumes ProjectOwnerWaiver. ProjectChainPolicy::from_grants accepts groups only, and check_project_object unconditionally passes false to the shared owner check. Reusing those APIs cannot reproduce S3 owner-waiver behavior, including the required discovery cases.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Assign the narrowly scoped typed-waiver plumbing to the appropriate sub-unit and applicable selection/unit-chain judgments, preserving X2 placement and non-owner custody checks and legacy behavior where required. Add a foreign-owned project inside an otherwise admissible home to avoid relying on the old outside-home case, plus no-flag, no-explicit-project and mode/ACL negative controls. Define marker-file waiver behavior from the governing rule rather than broadly weakening custody.

requiredFindings.location: Section 1 B2-b1 observe_child_kind and B2-b3 identity recheck
requiredFindings.title: Carry the by-name identity needed for the required observation/open comparison
requiredFindings.finding: observe_child_kind returns only Directory/File/Symlink/Other/Absent. The walker later promises to compare st_dev/st_ino between observation and open, but that return type discards both identifiers. A fresh post-open sample alone cannot detect a replacement between the original by-name observation and open.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Specify a charged no-follow by-name observation retaining kind and the identity metadata needed for the comparison, then compare it against the opened descriptor before using the object. Define absence/change behavior and refusal without retry. The swap control must replace an entry with another of the same kind and prove that the original identity is compared.
